title: Community Park-Based Programs for Health Promotion: Active Older Adults Prospective Cohort Study
official: Community Park-Based Programs for Health Promotion: Active Older Adults Prospective Cohort Study
summary: The Active Older Adults prospective cohort study examines the effects of a park-based fitness program on cardiovascular fitness outcomes for older adults (aged 50 years and older). Duke will perform a secondary analysis of the data collected as part of the Active Older Adults prospective cohort study run by Miami-Dade County Parks and Recreation.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged 50 years or older, residing in Miami-Dade County
* All participants enrolled in the Miami-Dade Active Older Adults study will be included in this secondary analysis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Aged less than 50 years, not residing in Miami-Dade County
* Anyone not enrolled in the Miami-Dade Active Older Adults study will be excluded from this secondary analysis
